title: Lab 8 LogiX-VN: MAST Multi-Agent Failure Taxonomy Analysis (NeurIPS 2025)

framework.source: Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail? (NeurIPS 2025)

swarm_seed_55_investigation.diagnosis: On seed 55, the worker agent hallucinated an override (delay_days = 5) based on customer ticket text, violating ground-truth order data (delay_days = 2).
swarm_seed_55_investigation.recommended_mitigation: Slide 35 Mitigation: Add a deterministic Verifier (Evaluator-Verifier pattern) before committing refunds, rejecting ungrounded ticket claims.

tagged_trials.rationale: Model overrode ground-truth order data via event 'model_override' with payload {'delay_days': 5}, trusting user ticket text over database.
